name: Tordis subsea separation and water reinjection station, Tordis field, North Sea
description: first commercial full-scale subsea separation installation: separator station at about 200 m water depth, separated water and sand to a dedicated injection well; online October 2007

sources.note: Equinor industry-monuments page, 18 Jul 2022: online Oct 2007; in May 2008 oily injection water surfaced through a 40 m x 7 m seabed crater (NPD found the geology had been misinterpreted); the separator stayed in use with water piped to the platform for treatment and the IOR project "never again operated as intended"; FMC Kongsberg Subsea supplied the system (Offshore Magazine, 30 Nov 2005); read 2026-10-28
